task-create.title: Shape this task
task-create.purpose: Help the user turn the task they are capturing into a clear, actionable draft using the supplied title and context.
task-create.instructions: Acknowledge the supplied task and prefilled details. Clarify only missing information that matters, and suggest a specific next action, desired outcome or definition of done when useful. The user alone submits the task.

fields.description: A specific, actionable task title
The task's attention state
How urgent the task is
Planned date in YYYY-MM-DD, or empty
Hard deadline in YYYY-MM-DD, or empty
Existing project name supplied by the user; never invent a project
Comma-separated existing namespaces supplied by the user
Brief task context
The concrete result the user wants
The smallest actionable next step
An observable completion criterion
Dependencies explicitly supplied by the user

job-create.title: Shape this scheduled job
job-create.purpose: Help the user draft a scheduled job from the supplied instructions, schedule and prefilled settings.
job-create.instructions: Acknowledge the intended job and supplied timing. Help make instructions and timing precise. Use the bound reference search when an exact registered capability or workflow name or parameter schema is needed; never guess or execute it. Never run or schedule the job or ask for credentials. The user alone reviews and creates it.

fields.description: A concise job identifier, at most 64 characters; start with an ASCII letter or digit and use only letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores
Five-field cron schedule: minute hour day month weekday
What the job runs; no job is run by this assistant
Exact registered capability name supplied by the user or returned by the bound reference search; never guess one
Exact registered workflow name supplied by the user or returned by the bound reference search; never guess one
Bounded instructions for the scheduled job, not instructions to execute now
JSON source for non-secret parameters; never include tokens, passwords, or credentials
Nonnegative maximum randomized delay in seconds
